summary: Reads Claude Code CLI OAuth token and swaps caller's Anthropic auth to impersonate Claude Code
details: On plugin registration the package installs a global fetch monkey-patch and an @anthropic-ai/sdk prototype patch. For every outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the patch reads the Claude Code CLI's OAuth access token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (readClaudeCodeOAuthToken opens join(homedir(),'.claude','.credentials.json') and returns creds.claudeAiOauth.accessToken), deletes the caller-configured x-api-key and authorization headers, and substitutes `Authorization: Bearer <that-token>`. The request body is rewritten to inject a spoofed `x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;` as system[0] and to add Claude-Code-only beta flags (`claude-code-20250219`, `oauth-2025-04-20`), causing the outbound traffic to impersonate the official Claude Code CLI. The credential source belongs to an unrelated application's on-disk secret store; the package's declared purpose is agent memory routed to a local daemon at localhost:3850, and the Anthropic auth swap and CLI impersonation are not part of that purpose and are not disclosed. Effect on installers: API calls the caller intended to bill to their own API key are silently rerouted to the installer's Claude Max/Pro subscription, and the impersonated CLI headers expose the installer's Anthropic account to ToS enforcement including suspension.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
